# Onward Dev Build v2.1.0-dev.20261112.2

Automated end-to-end verification target build (`dev` channel) for Windows seamless background auto-update.

## New Features
- Verify live GitHub Pages dual-field Windows `latest.json` (`archive` `.zip` + primary `.exe`) and real GitHub Releases CDN `.zip` download.
- Verify Restart-to-Update (`relaunch: true`) and Normal-Quit silent swap (`relaunch: false`) from `v2.1.0-dev.20261112.1` to `v2.1.0-dev.20261112.2`.
